name: blur-vignette-card
title: Blur Vignette Card
blurb: Image card with a blurred vignette edge and text overlay.
description: Demo component that shows BlurVignette and BlurVignetteArticle in action. Image has a radial blur gradient from edges. Text article is overlaid at bottom with custom styling. Configurable via radius, inset, blur, and transition props.
use_when: Feature cards, testimonials, or story showcases where an image with text overlay needs polish.
avoid_when: High-contrast or low-vision contexts where blur may reduce readability.
a11y: Image has alt text. Text content is readable. Blur is decorative only.
